global_rules: No arbitrary parent creation or mkdir -p. Only enumerated missing directories may be created.
No-overwrite publication for new paths. Any unexpected existing path, type, owner, mode, parent identity, symlink, or unproved completion causes STOP.
Same-filesystem requirement: staging, destinations and external quarantine must share st_dev. Verify immediately before mutation; no copy/unlink fallback.

Pin every existing ancestor before opening; revalidate descriptors and namespace before and after each operation. Parent timestamps naturally change on child insertion and are logged, not mistaken for an immutable directory identity.
Modes/owners of existing paths are preserved. New directory 0755, ancillary 0644, loose object 0444; metadata retains 0664.
Git object bytes are canonical Git envelope compressed with zlib, not raw blob contents; verify OID, type, length and raw SHA-256 after decompression.
Object and new file publication retains private staging anchors; equality of bytes alone never proves attempt ownership.

event_contract.grammar: INTENT(BEGIN), for each microstep BEFORE -> AFTER -> STAGED iff stage_checkpoint, DONE(COMPLETE); FINAL/DONE(SEAL:state) before any next-phase operation. All terminal and STOP handling fail closed. Rollback uses INTENT(ENTER_ROLLBACK), ordered BEFORE/AFTER/DONE per selected primitive, ROLLBACK/DONE(BARRIER:<phase>) for every phase including no-ops and PRE_ROLLBACK_SEAL, then FINAL/DONE(SEAL:ROLLED_BACK). POST_ROLLBACK_TERMINAL is read-only; no new event enum or path.
event_contract.proof_limit: Closed evidence is checked semantically against authenticated context and history. Actual bytes/descriptor observations and context authenticity remain mandatory adapter duties; chain hashes are not authentication.
event_contract.replay: 03_state_machine.semantic_replay; never derive authority or validity from completed prefixes supplied by caller.

normative_syscall_contract.STOP: A STOP append is allowed only on a valid nonterminal prefix with a writable ledger and known last-proved evidence. Never recursively append STOP while failing STOP or through a corrupt/torn tail.
normative_syscall_contract.descriptor_rule: Every ancestor occurrence is a separate no-follow open/fstat before and after. Actual syscall returns and held-fd namespace comparisons are required; composite content/graph checks expand internally into read-only byte/object validation in the reviewed adapter.
normative_syscall_contract.file_create: Exclusive open, initial fstat, complete write, fchmod new fd, fstat, file fsync, parent fsync, reopen no-follow, fstat/read/hash/fstat, ancestor revalidation. Applies identically to every ledger write.
normative_syscall_contract.read_only_composites: read/hash/index/tree/graph checks are named semantic actions, not claims of single kernel syscalls. Adapter review must expand all internal read sites, short-read/EINTR/EIO sites and per-object checks, preserving these occurrence bindings before isolated test acceptance.

identity_binding_contract.approved_aliases: baseline_alias_groups defines exact full membership and outside_links=0. Fresh preflight must establish nlink==membership count; unknown external aliases STOP. Every map retains each approved alias, unchanged. No missing/additional membership or split inode is permitted.

binding_schema.outside_links: nonnegative integer fixed by approved initial alias/child inventory; never recomputed from a possibly corrupted current observation

identity_binding_contract.directory_nlink: outside_links + count of currently PRESENT controlled direct child directories. outside_links = approved baseline nlink minus baseline controlled direct child directories; new dir outside_links=2. Original counts need fresh release-bound preflight; no new authority inferred.
identity_binding_contract.hashes: ORIGINAL and IMMUTABLE SHA-256 from authenticated preflight/published snapshot; CREATED O/F from exact program rules plus approved compressed streams; CANDIDATE index from separately approved release, HEAD=target+LF. Directories sha256=null.
identity_binding_contract.history_vs_present: Verify historical event records at their recorded identities; verify PRESENT namespace only from current phase/replayed microsteps, never require old staging pathname after move.
identity_binding_contract.inode_source: Approved baseline aliases share their canonical BASELINE_ALIAS token, derived by device/inode grouping of approved inventory. Other tokens MUST have distinct device/inode. New identities come only from proved exclusive creation; never predict them.
identity_binding_contract.microstep_namespace: Start at last forward barrier (or initial map); fold only durably proved AFTER effects for active operation in order: create adds bound token, link adds same token, move relocates token, exchange swaps tokens; no operation inferred from name/hash alone. Unrecorded side effects require exact before/after proof or STOP.
identity_binding_contract.owner: new UID=GID=1000; originals exactly pinned owner/group. No chown.
identity_binding_contract.regular_nlink: outside_links + number of current controlled namespace aliases; outside_links = authenticated baseline nlink minus controlled baseline aliases (new inode:0). No guessed ranges.

release_rule: Every null execution input is a mandatory unresolved gate. This manifest cannot authorize itself. Freeze a separate exact execution release; do not rewrite this proposal or historical inputs.

rollback_protocol.ambiguous_event_rule: A torn/incomplete event, orphan stage without durable identity proof, unmatched namespace, unexpected state or non-owned content is STOP. Preserve all artifacts; a separately reviewed custody decision is required, never reconstruct authority from filenames/hashes.
rollback_protocol.attempt_id_policy: One fixed attempt namespace, exclusively created. Resume only this recorded attempt; a second attempt requires a new reviewed namespace and approval.
rollback_protocol.control_files_mode: 0600; .original hardlink anchors and staged publication objects deliberately retain their original/target modes inside 0700 parents to avoid changing linked runtime metadata
rollback_protocol.durability: Write complete event; fsync event and ledger directory; then side effect. Fsync staged regular files and containing directory; fsync both parents after link/no-replace rename/exchange; verify exact paths and identities; persist AFTER then DONE with fsync. Directory operations fsync source/destination parents. Never record completion before actual durability checks.
rollback_protocol.exclusive_operator_lock: Acquire flock on the identity-pinned attempt-root directory descriptor; create no lock file. This serializes this procedure only; separately establish no concurrent external Git writer. Without that custody guarantee STOP.
rollback_protocol.ledger_format: Immutable canonical JSON events, one regular 0600 file per event; ledger/<ordinal:06d>-<operation_id>-<event>.json; finite operation IDs from allowlists plus PREPARE, VERIFY, ROLLBACK, FINAL; event enum INTENT, STAGED, BEFORE, AFTER, DONE, STOP. Creation O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW; never truncate/rewrite/delete. Repeated transition reads matching DONE instead of replaying mutation.
rollback_protocol.original_anchor_contract: Original HEAD/index hardlinks preserve original inode, byte content, owner and mode (0664). Anchors remain inside backup 0700. Only original metadata link-count/ctime changes caused by creating anchors are permitted and logged; source modules/authentication objects are never linked or changed. Byte backups are separate 0600 exclusive files.
rollback_protocol.quarantine_order_recovery: For each metadata operation, if live original and lock candidate => before exchange; if live candidate and lock original => after forward exchange; if live original and lock migrated candidate after ROLLBACK_INTENT => after reverse exchange. Exact AFTER/BEFORE records and anchor inode mapping disambiguate. Move lock only to its specified forward-old or rollback-new slot with no replacement. A matching destination plus absent lock is already complete. Any other combination STOP.
rollback_protocol.rollback_identity_limits: Restore original HEAD/index inode and bytes via anchors; do not claim restoration of original ctime, nlink or wall-clock history, which necessarily change. Record these transitions truthfully. Reflog is unchanged by this direct-metadata design; external ledger is the operation audit. No reflog overwrite/truncation.
rollback_order: Durably record ROLLBACK_INTENT; exclude concurrent Git/recovery actions; validate anchors and identity map.

Restore original HEAD first if it changed, by exact original-anchor exchange; then restore original index. If only index changed, leave old HEAD untouched. Resolve any owned lock path first using identity map; never remove a foreign lock.
Quarantine exactly the created ancillary subset in reverse F operation order; never move ambiguous paths.
Quarantine only the proven-created empty documentation directory after children; retain fanout dirs and objects.

Verify exact old detached HEAD/index bytes, owner/mode/original inode and baseline index flags, original two-entry status, module/service/authentication identities. Append ROLLED_BACK; retain all external control/backup/quarantine data and objects.
rollback_protocol.terminal_rule: VERIFIED or ROLLED_BACK is terminal for this attempt. Reentry verifies and returns, never reruns forward migration. No automatic rollback after any later successor/selector transition; obtain new governance.

semantic_evidence_contract.STOP: Closed durable STOP record: state STOP, microstep STOP, source/destination null, reason in IO_FAILURE/IDENTITY_MISMATCH/CUSTODY_LOST/REVOKED/VERIFICATION_FAILED, outcome UNKNOWN_RETAIN. Before is last proved map; after and after-parents/link changes null. No reconstruction of unknown side effect, no append after STOP, no automatic rollback.
semantic_evidence_contract.checks: Exactly [kind, microstep_id, state]; no unknown, missing, duplicate or reordered checks. STOP has empty checks. This is checked association, never evidence authentication.
semantic_evidence_contract.consistency: Snapshots chain across every event. BEFORE/INTENT/STAGED/DONE/seal/barrier have identical before/after snapshots. AFTER changes only the exact specified primitive; all identities, hashes, parents and nlink deltas must agree. Terminal evidence must match phase map and Git predicate. Event payloads never override replayed history.
semantic_evidence_contract.content_sha256: Exact token->sha256 map of all regular identities in the after snapshot (before snapshot for STOP).
semantic_evidence_contract.context_authority: Authenticated separate preflight/execution-release inputs. This package supplies none. Initial bindings include only initial present tokens plus the two initialization directories. Content hashes bind ALL future regular tokens before mutation, with program-known hashes enforced. No future inode is predicted.
semantic_evidence_contract.expected_git_oid_if_object: Exact {oid,object_type,raw_bytes,raw_sha256} from the O operation rule for every O event; null otherwise. Compressed bytes independently bound by context content_hashes.
semantic_evidence_contract.git_facts: Exact forward git_predicate at state seals and VERIFY AFTER/DONE. Exact original rollback Git facts at PRE_ROLLBACK_SEAL and ROLLED_BACK seal. Null otherwise.

kinds.DONE: OPERATION_COMPLETE or ROLLBACK_PRIMITIVE_COMPLETE or ROLLBACK_BARRIER (microstep BARRIER:<phase>) or STATE_SEAL

semantic_evidence_contract.link_count_changes: Exact token->{before,after} for every changed link count, including create and directory-child deltas; zero for absent token. Empty object when unchanged; null for STOP unknown outcome.
semantic_evidence_contract.parents: parent_before_identity/parent_after_identity are exact projections of all directory identities from the corresponding snapshot; no omitted/extra parents.

primitive_types.context: closed typed bindings/hash maps and rollback_plan list[str]
primitive_types.git_facts: null or exactly forward string fields (head is SHA1) or rollback string fields plus ancillary_present list[str]
primitive_types.snapshots: closed path maps of null or typed identities; STOP after maps null

semantic_evidence_contract.snapshot: before_identity and after_identity are exact full controlled-path maps of null or closed {dev,ino,file_type,uid,gid,mode,sha256,nlink}. Replay derives token locations independently, checks pinned metadata/content and link algebra, and binds a new inode only at its exact create AFTER.
semantic_evidence_contract.validation_order: Closed fields and primitive/container types, then canonical bytes and chain, then event ownership, then semantic effects and cross-event evidence. No input container is used as a string/hash/index. Every public validation boundary preserves explicit Stop reasons; unexpected malformed-input exceptions normalize to Stop(MALFORMED_INPUT), never a valid history or retroactive repair.
